fields.Name: Skip ICF - Members by Segment
fields.Description: Simple aggregation: count ICF members (MoreCheese: Member Profiles) by Segment, with a chart that drills into the member list. Ported from AssociationDB "Active Members by Type"; ICF has no membership-type subscriptions (orders are not booked), so the member Segment is the type dimension.

InputDefinition.userMessage: Show me how many members we have, broken down by member segment, in a chart. I'd like to be able to click on any segment to see the actual list of members in that segment. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a chart of member counts by segment
Uses the member profile data (MoreCheese: Member Profiles, Segment field) rather than inventing a membership-type table
All five segments are represented: Producer, Retailer, Enthusiast, Supplier, Educator
Counts are computed from data, not hardcoded; if totals are shown they are about 2,109 members (Producer about 843 is the largest segment, Educator about 163 the smallest)
Clicking a segment drills down to a table listing the members in that segment
Rows in the member table can open the underlying person or member profile record
